notes: Each version uses the same complete legal synthetic fixture, with equipped items at the tail for the 10000-item case.
One warmup per fixture and version is retained separately and excluded from statistics. Every measured pair alternates order.
The timer starts in native click capture and ends at the second rAF callback; both callbacks and any overlapping long tasks are retained. It excludes input before capture and is not field INP.
Opening and cancelling the dialog must preserve both complete durable save strings. No purchase is made during these timing samples.
No retries replace failed samples. Browser timings are software-rendered lab observations, not a general speed-up or hardware certification.
measuredAction: Native paid-choice click opens its confirmation dialog.
estimator: sorted floor((n-1)*p); with n=12, p95 is the 11th ordered value; maximum is reported separately. The tail sample is small.
